about: Innovations and firsts made in the isles (roadmap C6, 2026-10-25): inventions, discoveries and firsts placed where they were made, tried or first used, each with sources and exact quotes (checked by python -m bidb.evidence --check). `made_at` names the Wikipedia article of the building or place where it happened, linked to its catalogue record or place when the build has it (bidb.innovations). Claims of a world first are those of the source; the evidence notes say where an earlier rival exists. Verdict 'open' where a date or place needs a better source.

entries.name: Jethro Tull's seed drill
entries.claim: Jethro Tull refined the seed drill in 1701
entries.evidence: Seed drills were older (Sumer, China); Tull's horse-drawn drill is the one credited in England. The farm is placed by its locality.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Seed drill
sources.author: Wikipedia contributors
sources.quote: the seed drill was further refined by Jethro Tull in 1701 in the Agricultural Revolution
